question: Should memory-core hybrid search preserve keyword-only FTS hits below minScore when another merged result already passes minScore?
rationale: The implementation is a narrow bug-fix shape, but it changes the meaning of minScore for FTS-backed lexical hits that can enter agent context, which is a retrieval-policy choice maintainers should own before merge.

options.title: Refresh And Review This Fix

options.title: Accept The Retrieval Exception
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept that valid keyword-only FTS hits may bypass the weighted minScore cutoff as long as maxResults still bounds context size.

options.title: Pause For Unified Memory Policy
options.body: If minScore must remain an absolute cutoff, pause this PR and decide the CJK, keyword-only, and multimodal retrieval policies together.
